description: Submit a URL to ScanMalware to be rendered and analysed in an isolated analysis environment; returns the new scan_id. scan_type is required and sets who can see the result: 'public' lists the URL and its results in the public feed, visible to anyone and to search engines; 'unlisted' keeps the scan out of public listings, but anyone with its link can open it; 'private' limits the result to the ScanMalware account of this server's SCANMALWARE_BEARER_TOKEN and is rejected when no token is configured. Wraps POST /api/v1/scan of the ScanMalware API, documented at https://scanmalware.com/api-docs.

options.description: Optional scanner options as a JSON object, passed to the ScanMalware API unchanged; omit for the defaults.
options.title: Options

scan_type.description: Who can see the scan: public (listed in the public feed and search), unlisted (opens only with its link) or private (needs a ScanMalware account token on the server). Required; there is no default.
scan_type.title: Scan Type

url.description: Full URL to scan, including http:// or https://. Private, loopback and internal addresses are refused.
url.title: Url

user_agent.description: Optional User-Agent header to send with the submission request to the ScanMalware API.
user_agent.title: User Agent

name: submit_scan
title: Submit Scan
